from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as playwright:
    browser = playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp("http://localhost:9222/")
    page = browser.contexts[0].pages[0]

    # Search for an owner with the last name "Franklin"
    # Assuming there's a search input field for last name
    last_name_input = page.locator("input[name='lastName'], input[placeholder*='Last Name'], input[placeholder*='last name']").first
    last_name_input.fill("Franklin")

    # Submit the search form
    page.locator("button[type='submit'], input[type='submit']").first.click()

    # Wait for the results to load
    page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Verify that "George Franklin" can be seen as an owner
    assert "George Franklin" in page.content(), "George Franklin not found in the page content"

    print(page.url)
    print(page.content())
```
